subject: Re: Kickoff: worst-case recall — repro done, internal validation early read
body:
Hi both,

Status:

- Repro milestone met. On CIFAR-100 long-tail, Algorithm 1 lifts worst-case (minimum per-class) recall by a wide margin over standard ERM, and beats both the balanced-loss and re-weighted baselines, at a modest cost to average accuracy — the same trade the paper reports. The release's test mode made the setup verification painless.
- Internal workload early read: on our long-tail workload (about 400 classes, heaviest-to-lightest ratio ~900:1), worst-case recall goes from 0.12 under ERM to 0.41 with the cost-sensitive loss, average accuracy down 1.8 points. That trade needs a product conversation — some customers will take it instantly, others won't.
- Risk: convergence. The per-class multiplier updates oscillate on classes with <20 examples; Umar is damping the update rate, which stabilizes things at the cost of ~15% more epochs. Needs to settle before Paloma freezes trainer defaults.

On plan for mid-June.

Carmen
